name: FreeDeck
subtitle: FreeDeck — free, open-source app environment for iOS.
description: FreeDeck is a free, open-source app environment for iOS, built on LiveContainer: a multi-window launcher that offloads apps, games and web ports to your own server over Tailscale. No subscription, no account, no paid certificates.

apps.name: FreeDeck
apps.subtitle: Your apps. Your server. Zero local storage.
apps.versionDescription: Initial FreeDeck release: paywalls removed, server library, web ports, pairing-file JIT and location spoofing.
